question.text: Which entity is the regulatory authority specifically for the securities market in India?

answer.text: Securities and Exchange Board of India

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 257-258 of the NISM XV workbook identify SEBI as the regulatory authority for the securities market in India. SEBI regulates the securities market and registers and regulates market intermediaries and persons associated with the securities market. The Trap: RBI regulates banking and monetary policy. MCA regulates companies. IRDAI regulates insurance. None is the primary securities-market regulator. Note: Source-backed by NISM Series XV Research Analyst Workbook (February 2026), pages 257-258.
